style: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 4 and up: soft digital gouache with a gentle hand-painted texture, clean rounded shapes, thick-and-thin dark-brown outlines, warm friendly palette (jade and lime greens, warm ochre and terracotta, teal and turquoise, soft lilac, a touch of coral and sunny yellow), simple big eyes with a small highlight, rosy cheeks, calm smiling expressions; chubby, rounded, cuddly baby-like dinosaurs with soft blunt horns, plates and spikes, mouths closed or gently smiling, no visible teeth, no sharp claws, no scary elements, no text, no watermarks.
styleSheet: A style sheet on a plain white background, four sticker subjects standing side by side, all facing slightly to the left, whole bodies visible and not overlapping: a young, round, green T. rex with tiny arms and a big closed-mouth smile, a chubby orange Triceratops with three soft blunt horns and a round frill, a teal Stegosaurus with rounded coral back plates, and a lilac Pteranodon standing with its wings folded. Plus a small swatch of prehistoric scenery in the bottom corner: a little tree fern, a cycad with a cone and a mossy terracotta rock. Consistent style, palette and line weight across everything. No text.

stickers.prompt: A gentle, chubby baby-faced Brachiosaurus, a long-neck dinosaur: a round soft sage-green body with pale cream belly and faint darker spots, four sturdy pillar legs, a short tail, and a very long neck rising up high with a small round head at the top, big kind eyes and a sleepy, happy closed-mouth smile. Facing slightly to the left, whole body visible, standing on nothing (no ground, no grass, no props).
stickers.faceNote: Its small round head sits on top of the long neck; the head's shape, the snout and the green spots stay exactly as they are; only the eyes, brows, mouth and cheeks change. It has TWO eyes — the far one, smaller, nearer the snout, and the near one, bigger — and both always show the same expression; never remove or add an eye. Never show teeth, even with an open mouth.

stickers.faceNote: The snout stays exactly as drawn: orange and rounded, with its small nostril and the little cream nose horn on top — never turn it into a big cream beak. The three soft cream horns and the orange frill stay exactly as they are, same size and colour; only the eyes, brows, mouth and cheeks change. stickers.faceNote: It has TWO eyes, and the far one must always be there: a small eye just above the top edge of the hooked beak, near the head's front outline; the near one is big. expressions.prompt: happy — a big, warm, open smile, the eyes smiling (curved upward, crinkled with joy), cheeks lifted and rosy.
a little sad — eyebrows tilted up in the middle, eyes soft and a bit droopy, a small downturned mouth. Gentle, not crying, no tears.
fast asleep — both eyes peacefully closed as soft curved lines, a small relaxed mouth, calm and cosy.
delighted surprise — eyes wide open and round, eyebrows raised high, a small round open "o" mouth. Amazed and happy, never scared.

scene.background: A sunny, peaceful prehistoric valley seen from a small child's eye height, laid out as in the layout image but WITHOUT the tall trees at its left and right edges (those are painted later on their own layers): a calm turquoise lagoon on the left and middle with a gently sloping sandy-mud shore curving across the left half, smooth pebbles along it and four giant round water-lily pads near the left bank; its far side and the distance on the right ringed by low, layered ochre-and-terracotta mesas and flat-topped red rocks with a few small monkey-puzzle trees and cycads on top; far away, just right of the centre behind the mesas, a small, gentle, green-sloped, flat-topped dormant volcano with NO smoke, NO steam, NO lava and NO glow, calm and friendly; soft lilac-blue hills behind; a wide, flat, open meadow of short ferns and grass across the centre and right, the middle wide open; one big, low, flat-topped warm terracotta rock ledge standing on the meadow in the right middle ground, as in the layout, its broad flat sunny top good for basking; a small golden fan-leaved ginkgo and a clump of giant green horsetails at the back right of the meadow; a clear warm pale-blue sky with a few round soft clouds. Exotic prehistoric plants only: it must not look like a European woodland. No animals, no dinosaurs, no birds, no people.
scene.foreground: Only a few low prehistoric plants in the two bottom corners, nothing else: in the bottom-left corner a small cycad with stiff palm-like fronds and one golden cone, a curled fern fiddlehead beside it and a round mossy boulder; in the bottom-right corner a low clump of short giant-horsetail shoots and small ferns beside a mossy terracotta stone. Each clump is no wider than a sixth of the picture and no taller than a tenth of it, sitting on the bottom edge. No trees, no trunks. The bottom edge between the two corners, the whole centre and everything above stay fully transparent.
scene.foregroundWideOwn: The same two small corner clumps at the wide picture's own bottom corners, each the same size as in the attached 4:3 foreground; everything else fully transparent.

layers.prompt: a tall monkey-puzzle tree (araucaria) seen whole from its roots to its top, about two and a half times as tall as it is wide: a straight, tall brown trunk with rough, scaly bark and a slight lean, a few roots and small ferns at its foot; at the top an umbrella-shaped crown of long curving branches in tiers, each covered in soft-looking dark-green scale leaves like ropes; a little below the crown one long, nearly level branch reaches out to the left, good to sit on.

a big tree fern seen whole from its roots to the top of its crown, about one and a half times as tall as it is wide: a stout, shaggy brown trunk covered in old frond scales, slightly curved, a few roots and small ferns at its foot; a huge, full, lacy crown of long arching bright-green fronds spreading out to both sides at the top, one young frond still curled into a fiddlehead; below the crown one sturdy old frond stalk reaches out to the right, nearly level, good to sit on.

sky.description: the open sky over the valley, between the tree fern and the monkey-puzzle tree

lagoon.description: the calm turquoise lagoon on the left, with giant water-lily pads near its left bank

shore.description: the sandy-mud bank with pebbles along the near side of the lagoon

meadow.description: the wide open meadow of short ferns and grass in the middle and on the right

rocks.description: the flat top of the big warm terracotta rock ledge on the right of the meadow, good for basking

branches.description: the long low frond stalk of the tree fern on the left and the low branch of the monkey-puzzle tree on the right

notes.stickers: Every character faces slightly left, whole body visible. Living things get faces; nothing inorganic does (eggs, log, puddle, big leaf). Nothing scary: no teeth, no sharp claws, no predation. Edit prompts freely; a changed prompt re-renders only that sticker.
